505496: _In a little-known corner of Mothershroom Woods, a small house stands quietly, undisturbed._
505497: _The cavern lies hidden between sheer cliffs, where clusters of mushrooms intertwine and conceal one another. Even the Shroomlings who frequently visit Mothershroom Woods rarely notice its presence._
505498: _Winding along the twisting path, nameless flowers bloom across the meadows. Before the fated arrival, only the wind can knock upon the door of Itzaland._
505499: _The distant, salty sea breeze drifts in, and the outlines of the towering trees fade. The faint roar of the waves stirs the hearts of adventurers, guiding them toward unknown journeys._
505500: _In the higher reaches of the forest, the distant Crystal Beach sparkles under the sunlight, bearing witness to the passage of the Titan civilization._
505501: _The desolate Rockville has now become a playground for wild beasts, while the traces of Titans have long been eroded by the waves._
505502: _From the lakeside, distant, dazzling Crystal Beach shimmers with enchanting light, gently adorning the rolling forests beyond._
505503: _Magical herbs grow by the clear lakeside, quietly awaiting the arrival of those destined to find them._
505504: _The dock in Mothershroom Woods that leads to Shell Island. Shroomling boatmen wait here, ready to carry fully prepared adventurers safely across the island._

505506: _A clothing vending machine created by the Whale Consortium. Rumble, rumble... the surprise ball is rolling, and your heart is racing!_

505511: _On a secluded, unseen slope, nameless little flowers grow and spread quietly._
505512: _Among crumbling walls and thriving greenery, adventurers rest, enjoying brief peace as they prepare for tomorrow's journey._
505513: _Everything is frozen in time. The scenes of the past fade away, and civilization slumbers here._
505514: _Weathered cracks cover the stone entrance, and towering trees coil among the broken walls and ruins. Each fissure tells the story of a long-buried history._
505515: _Leaf River murmurs gently, awaiting a destined traveler to embark on an exhilarating journey along its winding waters._
505516: _A mysterious cavern, where only adventurers with sincere hearts and courage can traverse time to uncover the traces of a brilliant civilization._
505517: _The heavy stone monument stands silently, burying both the fragrance of the flowering trees and the glory of past times._
505518: _Winding paths flanked by flowers and leaves lead to tiny jar-shaped homes, the warm abodes of little Shroomlings._
505519: _The entrance to Misty Forest. Beyond a heavy door, mysterious fog rapidly spreads, sealing away the remnants of the Titan civilization._
505520: _The fine, soft sand stretches out as the waves murmur gently. The footprints of adventurers mark Itzaland, and the prologue of their journey starts here._
505521: _Elderwood Forest Grand Adventurer Camp. Adventurers from all lands gather, their hearts burning with curiosity, trading tales of wonder beneath the towering trees._
505522: _Countless clay jars huddle together among the ruins, and echoes of the past bustle still inger faintly in the air._
505523: _Beneath the crumbling bricks, giant vines quitely take root, as the remnants of civilization are slowly reclaimed by the vitality of nature._
505524: _Towering trees stand by the broken bridge, branches and leaves interwoven. The wind howls through the bridges remains, and for a fleeting moment, it sounds as though a distant Behemoth is letting out a low, echoing roar._
505525: _A colossal being slumbers here, a witness to birth and decay alike. Every gaze upon it is a glimpse into the endless cycle of life._
505526: _Here, contrasting hues meet by chance. Gold and emerald intertwine in harmony._
505527: _Green vines drape over the fallen Elderwoods, leaving the ruins in a haunting silence._

930624: _In the Everbloom Garden, constant harvests are achieved not through nature's pulse, but through spinning cogs._
930625: _Water courses silently through the planting area, where fruit hang heavily on the vines in the light._
930626: _An evergreen garden, raised by gears, that quietly spread warmth and joy throughout Heaven's Reach during the fruiting season._
930627: _A market located in the Center District, offering a vast selection of goods despite its small size._
930628: _Most of the mechanisms at the gate to the Golden Court halted after the fall of the Titans._
930629: _Sometimes, sunlight spills gently across the space, bathing the entire Golden Tooth Candy Works in a warm, golden glow._
930631: _A side door reserved for repairment, set into the side of the Golden Court like a silent gear._
930632: _The bridge stretches across the lake, leading to the dazzling yet silent Golden Court._

930634: _Slanting rays of sunlight quietly fill the theater covered in the silent dust of yesterday's applause._
930635: _On the ever-so-grand plaza before the Golden Court, Cogbuds travel on paths unchanged for a thousand years._
930636: _The once lively dock has long since been forgotten, occupied only by the low hum of the wind passing through the empty corridors._
930637: _Stone tablets stack into steps. Pages spread into rivers. Here, thought collide and leave their mark, never ceasing._
930638: _Unfinished manuscripts pile up in the long corridor, where knowledge is tempered into its purest form._
930639: _Wind blows past the fields by the Hall, picking up echoes of old wisdom between blades of grass._
930640: _This was once the cradle of civilization, where the greatest minds lit up an entire era._
930642: _Broken Colonnades float in midair, like a tomb slowly drowning into the sky._
930643: _The Golden Court hangs high above, its shadow marred by scar-like ruins._
930645: _The green vines and dappled sunlight seem to be telling stories of the past._
930646: _The rusted Automaton rests with its wings retracted, as if still waiting for a ceremony that has long since concluded._
